prompts.name: 战前确认_v2
prompts.prompt: Create a polished full-screen 16:9 landscape game UI ideal concept for a Chinese single-player cultivation tactical battle game. This is a NEW concept illustration, not an in-game screenshot. Cohesive traditional Chinese ink wash and restrained mineral pigment on warm mottled paper, misty blue-gray mountain valley, muted olive pines, broad stone courtyard. UI: deep desaturated ink teal lacquer, thin aged gray-beige trim, modest corner cloud curls, matte paper inset panels, warm ivory legible Chinese typography. Absolutely NO bright metallic gold, thick ornate frames, neon, western fantasy, sci-fi, modern glossy widgets. The composition should feel like the user's established illustrated Chinese ink battle interface. Crisp readable typography, generous margins, safe text insets away from ornaments. Full canvas 1672x941 equivalent, high quality. Use actual Chinese text below; all numbers are merely concept examples, not balance decisions. No XP bars, no invented currencies, no replay/revive/ads buttons. SCREEN ONE: PRE-BATTLE CONFIRMATION. Top center moderate heading '山谷遭遇', smaller subtitle '战前确认'; top-left small location text '山谷石坪'. Main centered airy horizontal framed panel occupying x12%-88%, y20%-76%, split into two equal sections with a small ink-brush '对阵' between. Left '我方' portrait of one blue-robed long-haired young swordsman facing right on paper, name '林清远', realm '云息一层'; right '敌方' weathered brown-clad bandit facing left, name '山道盗匪', realm '凡人'. Portraits large but not crowded; below each neatly aligned two-column concise stats: left '生命 192/192', '速度 110', '遁速 100', green flame icon '体力 3/6', blue droplet '法力 0/0'; right '生命 196/196', '速度 100', '遁速 100', '状态 正常'. An unobtrusive compact lower inset summary row with three sections: '每轮行动 5', '目标 击败敌方', '撤退 可尝试'. Below summary small neutral note '撤退占一个行动位，成功率按双方遁速计算'. Bottom center dominant deep teal '开始战斗' button with subtle pale jade highlight and smaller adjacent '查看属性' button. No cancel/free escape button for this encounter. No skillbar, no battle timeline. Render one complete beautiful usable screen, not a collage.
